content: Apply the phenylephrine/pramoxine/glycerin/petrolatum preparation to the cleansed area externally or to the lower portion of the anal canal. This can be applied up to four times daily, particularly at night, in the morning, or after bowel movements that may aggravate hemorrhoids. For application in the lower anal canal, remove the cover from the dispensing cap and attach the dispensing cap to the tube. For intrarectal use, remove the cover from the applicator, attach the applicator to the ointment tube, lubricate the applicator thoroughly, and gently insert the applicator into the rectum. After each use, clean the applicator and replace the cover. For children under 12 years of age, use is dependent on the patient’s condition and whether the benefits outweigh the risks. For individuals aged 12 years or older, apply the preparation to the cleansed area externally or to the lower portion of the anal canal, up to four times daily, especially at night, in the morning, or after bowel movements that may exacerbate hemorrhoids. This product is for external use only. Keep it out of the reach of children. It contains phenylephrine, so caution is advised in patients with heart disease, hypertension, hyperthyroidism, diabetes, thyroid disease, or prostatic hypertrophy. Discontinue use and consult a physician if hemorrhoids worsen or do not improve within seven days. Stop use if bleeding, allergic reactions, redness, irritation, swelling, pain, or other symptoms develop or worsen. Consult a healthcare professional if you are currently taking medications for hypertension or depression. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage unless directed by a healthcare professional. Do not insert the product into the rectum using fingers, mechanical devices, or applicators unless specifically instructed. Always consult a healthcare professional before use. In pregnancy, this product is generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
